test_title: PYST 169: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13 Feb, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. P is sitting second to the right of Q. S is an immediate neighbour of both Q and R. U is sitting third to the left of R. T is an immediate neighbour of both P and R. Who is the immediate neighbour of P and Q?
solution:
Given: Six students P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) P is sitting second to the right of Q.

2) S is an immediate neighbour of both Q and R.

3) T is an immediate neighbour of both P and R.

4) U is sitting third to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a8926978b0990e4b6dce34c87710058bcd8b7eff4ff9dd1969b1f28cde082d9.png] 

Here, 'T' is the immediate neighbour of P and Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
